$description: Process builds for print. Hand-authored, unlike every other token file, because the value that matters is the one that comes back on paper and no formula knows it. Seeded from a naive sRGB conversion and NOT PROOFED. Replace each `cmyk` after a printed proof; nothing else in the repository has to change.

navy.$description: Naive conversion of #101554. A 67% black component will print flat; a printer will very likely want something nearer C100 M90 Y20 K30 with a rich black. Ask, then put the answer here.

pink.$description: Naive conversion of #EF2F88, and the value most likely to be wrong. #EF2F88 is outside CMYK gamut: it will come back duller and warmer whatever the build. The yellow component is what decides how far towards coral it goes, so it is the number to argue about with a proof in hand. A spot colour is the alternative and needs a fan deck under daylight, which is why `spot` is null rather than a guess.

black.$description: Single-plate reproduction. For a large solid area a printer will want a rich black instead; this value is for type and line work.
